usage.desc: `required` only paints the asterisk — validation stays with you.
Passing a string switches the field to its error state and shows the message below it.
Adds the show/hide toggle. Do not combine it with a right icon of your own.
The clearable, search or unit-toggle patterns: an icon of your choice plus its handler.
For fields that resolve something async (a lookup by code, a remote validation).

`required` and `rules` run when leaving the field; the error shows in writing, is announced to screen readers and clears as soon as the value is fixed. To validate on submit, call `ref.validate()` on each field.
The focused field (label and error included) always stays above the keyboard: the root UIProvider takes care of it, no Screen or ScrollView needed.
